narrative: Automated version bump integrated into Makefile's test-release target. Twine now uploads using the explicit TestPyPI URL. README and changelog document the new flow.
user_input:
twine upload --repository-url https://test.pypi.org/legacy/ dist/*

that is the appropriate command and make sure to include full automation of version bump
scene: Developers invoke 'make test-release' to bump the patch version, run tests, build, and upload to TestPyPI in one step.
